description: This file defines types, functions, and a main merging function for handling hybrid search results, including scoring, ranking, and re-ranking with MMR and temporal decay configurations.

methods.name: buildFtsQuery
methods.description: Constructs a full-text search query string from raw input by tokenizing and quoting tokens.

methods.name: bm25RankToScore
methods.description: Converts a BM25 rank to a normalized score, handling finite, infinite, and negative ranks.

methods.name: mergeHybridResults
methods.description: Merges vector and keyword search results, applies scoring, temporal decay, and optional MMR re-ranking, returning sorted results.
